lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured matrix of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows starting posterior to the gill slits and extending posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp longitudinal ridge feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with highlights on top and shadows below.
